config._note: cao-library (2026-07-14): read-only reference detail for one CAO (derived projection of lib/Standards/cao/{caoId}.json). The 'CAO' data widget surfaces the identity + verification flags (caoId/name/sector/version/effectiveDate/payScalesVerified/leaveEntitlementVerified/source); the 'Loonschalen & verlof' widget surfaces the actual scales/allowances/leave/working-time maps -- the reference facts a maintainer checks a contract against. No lifecycleActions (Cao has no x-openregister-lifecycle), no create/edit affordances (corpus-authored). Audit history is a sidebar tab.

params.title: CAO's
params.description: Beschikbare CAO's uit de onderhouden CAO-bibliotheek (referentie, alleen-lezen).
params.note: cao-library (2026-07-14): read-only reference index over the maintained CAO corpus (lib/Standards/cao/), seeded from CaoRegistry via NlCaoChecks::seedObjects(). allowCreate:false plus actionToggles hiding Add/edit/delete/mass-actions -- the corpus is the single authoring source; these Cao objects are a derived display projection and MUST NOT be hand-authored. Rows navigate to CaoDetail.
